# Multiple OLS

::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives
- Understand how multiple regressors affect coefficient interpretation
- Interpret coefficients as partial effects holding other variables constant
- Recognize sources of omitted variable bias
:::

::: {.callout-important}
### Key Takeaways
- Multiple regression isolates the marginal effect of each regressor
- Coefficient estimates depend on which controls are included
- Adding relevant covariates can substantially change estimated effects
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### Common Pitfalls
- Interpreting coefficients without conditioning on included controls
- Assuming more controls always improve causal interpretation
- Ignoring multicollinearity among regressors
:::

Why multiple OLS matter in applied econometrics.
